title: Zoom calls: automatic filing into year and month folders (ships switched off)
text: A call recorded on the Mac arrives as a date-named folder at the top of Business > Zoom Calls, and until now someone had to file it by hand with Sort by date. A new automatic job, running every 10 minutes, files a finished call folder into TD Zoom Calls, where Sort by date puts it in year and month folders. A call inside a Marketing booking goes to TD Marketing Calls instead. It ships switched off, so nothing is filed automatically until it is turned on.
points: A folder is filed only after nothing in it has changed for 10 minutes and no upload for it is open.
At most 10 calls per run, and only folders are moved.
Each filing is written to the activity log with where the call came from: a Calendly booking or started straight from Zoom.
